title: Meet the 441K 'everyday millionaires' created in the US in 2025
title_zh: 来认识一下 2025 年美国创造的 44.1 万名“日常百万富翁”
summary: UBS has reported a spike in "everyday millionaires" in 2025 as 1,200 US millionaires were created every day last year, amounting to over 440,000 new millionaires.
summary_zh: 瑞银报告称，2025 年“日常百万富翁”数量将激增，去年每天新增 1,200 名美国百万富翁，总计超过 44 万新百万富翁。

title: Tokenmaxxing is out, but companies are still spending on AI. What's changed?
title_zh: Tokenmaxxing 已经退出，但企业仍在人工智能上投入。发生了什么变化？
summary: In just a short amount of time, corporate policy on "tokenmaxxing" — or excessively using AI models to inflate usage on internal leaderboards — has already peaked and valleyed.
summary_zh: 在短短的时间内，公司关于“tokenmaxshing”（即过度使用人工智能模型来增加内部排行榜上的使用量）的政策已经达到了顶峰和谷底。
